svg.title: How a new transfer ends
svg.desc: A submitted TransferFactory_Transfer ends Completed or Pending. Completed, when the payee holds a transfer preapproval for the payer: one update creates the payee's holding and the payer's change; Payvol reads it as settled, Match matches it by reference, and the Observe library does not record this path yet. Pending: a transfer offer waits. The payee accepts, typically Completed (settled), rejects (rejected), the payer withdraws (withdrawn), or the deadline passes and it can no longer be accepted (it stays offered and the request stays open). A result Payvol's trust policy does not name is unknown, never settled.
svg.text: The Token Standard result for each path, and how Payvol reads it.
